scripts.dev:server: uv run --project src/backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir src/backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3001 --reload
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @puredown/shared lint && pnpm --filter @puredown/web lint && uv run --project . --directory src/backend --extra dev ruff check app tests && uv run --project . --directory src/backend --extra dev mypy app
scripts.test: uv run --project src/backend --extra dev pytest -q src/backend/tests && pnpm --filter @puredown/web test
scripts.api:types: uv run --project src/backend python src/backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript src/backend/openapi.json -o src/shared/src/api.generated.ts
